description:
**Phase B — SessionManager. Deps: B1, B2.**

Port of `buildSessionContext` from `tmp/pi-mono/.../session-manager.ts`. Assembles LLM-ready message list from current branch.

Critical detail (verified at `session-manager.ts:390-392`): when a `CompactionEntry` exists, the synthetic `createCompactionSummaryMessage` is inserted at the **START** of the kept-message list (NOT interleaved). Skip entries before `firstKeptEntryId`; inject the synthetic message; then append the kept window.

Synthetic message construction lives in E3; this ticket owns the placement logic.

Tests: port `tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/test/session-manager/build-context.test.ts`.
